💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Drum-Belly: Strike the taut drum. When the belly swells drum-taut, STRIKE — the stretched skin is thin as a drumhead and the thunderclap backfires, stunning it senseless. Hit the drum, not the drummer. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Night Court: Dodge twice. No sound is the tell — watch the ground-shadow. A missed dive comes again instantly at your NEW position: dodge TWICE. Then it's exhausted, and the sky is yours. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Lockpick: Buy it off. It steals FIRST and fights second — but it CANNOT resist food. OFFER FOOD in the fight: it drops your things mid-scamper for the meal. A bribe is cheaper than a chase. (You lived to tell it — twice — and now you see the pattern.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Hushpuppy: Wound the lead. Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free. (You did the thing — and it worked.)
💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Bulldozer: Step OFF the lane. When it lowers its head, step OFF the lane — sideways, not back. It can't turn and it never goes around. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Living Wire: Get OUT of the water. When the crackling starts, step onto dry ground — the discharge cannot reach you there. On land it is just a long blind fish: slow, harmless, dinner. Never fight it standing in the creek. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Extended Warranty: Never stand still. The RING is the telegraph — the pitch itself gives no warning. Move two or more tiles from where you stood when it dialed and the call drops. It can only dial a stationary target. Never stand still. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Performance Review: Dodge unpredictably. It grades your dodges aloud — so stop giving it the same dodge twice. Move two rounds running, never the same way, and its lock breaks. Unpredictability is the only passing grade. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Flashbulb Moth: Hit it while it folds. The Wing Flash only fires FORWARD — it must face you. Circle while it folds its wings and hit it before the wings open. It can't flash what's behind it. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Landlord: Never end on leased ground. Rent comes due every round you end on leased ground — keep moving and the ledger starves. Each ADDENDUM raises the rent and heals it. Never end two rounds on the same dirt. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
